related.title: EDNS(0)：公告大小與路徑 UDP 預算
related.titleEn: EDNS(0): advertised size and path UDP budget
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受300/120 s期限與錯誤種類匹配；不能把SERVFAIL當已證明不存在。 交接時須能核對：交付 negative-cache.csv與名稱新增前後的來源對照時間圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept300/120 s only with the matching response type; SERVFAIL does not prove nonexistence. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver negative-cache.csv and provenance-aware timelines around name creation.
related.difference: 記錄公告值、實際DNS長度、TC旗標與傳輸方式，區分能力和路徑限制。
related.differenceEn: Record advertisement, actual DNS length, TC flag and transport, separating capability from path limits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
負回應快取期限取SOA本身TTL與SOA MINIMUM較小值，不能沿用某個正回應TTL。
教學基準：min(900,300) = 300 s；對照：min(900,120) = 120 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

EDNS UDP payload公告是接收能力，並不保證路徑可不分片傳遞同樣大小。
教學基準：min(4096,1280-40-8) = 1232 B；對照：min(4096,1500-40-8) = 1452 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Negative-cache lifetime uses the smaller of the SOA TTL and SOA MINIMUM rather than a positive-record TTL.
Teaching baseline: min(900,300) = 300 s; comparison: min(900,120) = 120 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

An EDNS UDP-payload advertisement is receiver capability, not a guarantee of unfragmented path delivery.
Teaching baseline: min(4096,1280-40-8) = 1232 B; comparison: min(4096,1500-40-8) = 1452 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TCP SACK：區間聯集與遺失洞計算
related.titleEn: TCP SACK: interval unions and missing-byte holes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受300/120 s期限與錯誤種類匹配；不能把SERVFAIL當已證明不存在。 交接時須能核對：交付 negative-cache.csv與名稱新增前後的來源對照時間圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept300/120 s only with the matching response type; SERVFAIL does not prove nonexistence. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver negative-cache.csv and provenance-aware timelines around name creation.
related.difference: 以半開區間正規化SACK blocks，與累積ACK分開儲存。
related.differenceEn: Normalize SACK blocks as half-open intervals and store them separately from cumulative ACK.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
負回應快取期限取SOA本身TTL與SOA MINIMUM較小值，不能沿用某個正回應TTL。
教學基準：min(900,300) = 300 s；對照：min(900,120) = 120 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

SACK描述已收到的位元組區間；區間可能重疊，不能直接相加造成重複計數。
教學基準：5000-(1000+1000+1000) = 2000 B missing；對照：5000-(1000+1000+1000+1000) = 1000 B missing。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Negative-cache lifetime uses the smaller of the SOA TTL and SOA MINIMUM rather than a positive-record TTL.
Teaching baseline: min(900,300) = 300 s; comparison: min(900,120) = 120 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

SACK describes received byte ranges; ranges may overlap and must not be naively summed.
Teaching baseline: 5000-(1000+1000+1000) = 2000 B missing; comparison: 5000-(1000+1000+1000+1000) = 1000 B missing. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
